crossRefs.note: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his…
Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Abigail hurried, and arose, and rode on a donkey, with five ladies of hers who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
translations.bsb: So Abigail hurried and got on a donkey, and attended by five of her maidens, she followed David’s messengers and became his wife.
translations.kjv: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
translations.asv: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
